name: Cloudflare MCP Servers

demo.title: The Cloudflare API MCP in Under 3 Minutes

what: Cloudflare's official remote MCP servers. The recommended Cloudflare API server (mcp.cloudflare.com, maintained in the cloudflare/mcp repo) covers the whole Cloudflare API through a small set of code-mode tools; the domain-specific servers in this repo cover docs, Browser Run, containers and more. All are hosted, so there is nothing to install. Apache-2.0.
who: Developers who run sites, Workers or DNS on Cloudflare and want the agent to read or change their setup. Some features need a paid Workers plan.

setup.text: Add the Cloudflare API server to your MCP client and sign in with OAuth when prompted:
For CI or automation, use the same URL with a Cloudflare API token as a Bearer token instead of OAuth.
Need only Cloudflare docs? Point your client at https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp instead.
The agent can change real settings in your account, so review its actions before approving them.

prompts: List my Cloudflare zones and show the DNS records for my main domain.
Using the Cloudflare docs server, explain how to add a KV binding to a Worker.
Create a KV namespace called cache in my account and show me its ID.
